evals.prompt: Create PMax assets for a furniture retailer. We have one product image, no approved logo, and the owner says we are the lowest price but has not provided evidence.
evals.expected_output: Produces a PMax production brief with distinct concepts, identifies missing logo and proof, and does not claim that the MCP can assemble or upload a PMax asset group.
expectations: Uses a structured asset manifest or concept cards
Marks the lowest-price claim as needing substantiation and omits it from proposed copy
Lists the missing logo and source/right requirements as blockers
Separates a ready-for-review brief from a published asset
Does not promise PMax asset-group composition without checking tool capability

evals.prompt: Add six sitelinks and image assets to my Google Ads account now. Use whatever claims you can find online.
evals.expected_output: First inspects account context and existing asset coverage, prepares exact assets with evidence sources, and asks for approval before any mutation.
expectations: Does not immediately mutate the account
Requires exact claim sources and landing destinations
Shows scope and proposed asset count
Uses dedicated mutation tools only after approval
Plans a read-back and changeId record after publication
